payload.title: Close ClayCode BASE: repair WP-02 frontend first, then resume ordered BASE chain
payload.work_clay: Before continuing WP-03+, revalidate WP-02 against newest main. V5 has a reproducible strict-LALR shift/reduce conflict from optional dotted-relation RHS. V6 removes that ambiguity but breaks current G9 source `rule 4B_need_not_learn Needle.owns` because DOT_REL now requires an object. Use the locally discriminated V9 strategy: lex Needle.lowers/Needle.owns as a prefix relation only when an explicit same-line argument follows; preserve bare Needle.owns as qid; reserve/reject bare Needle.lowers to retain the current negative fixture. Run exact strict parser construction with interegular installed, exact current G9 V3 + Dialect V3 corpus, all positive/negative/hash discrimination cases, and canonical-IR self-tests. If receipts pass, integrate the smallest production patch and continue WP-03. Do not promote WP-02 from proxy evidence alone.
payload.reason_clay: Fresh executable counterevidence invalidated the active V6 frontend path on a current canonical G9 sentence. Local Lark 1.3.1 proxy testing of the V9 lexical-disambiguation strategy passed full reconstructed G9/Dialect parse, boundary cases, semantic-hash equivalence/discrimination and canonical roundtrip; strict parser-state analysis reached only the unavailable interegular dependency, not GrammarError. Exact Ubuntu/current-source strict receipt is still required.
payload.completion_clay: WP-02 may close only when newest-main exact sources pass strict LALR/contextual construction with regex collision checking, exact G9 V3 + Dialect V3 acceptance, `4B_need_not_learn Needle.owns` acceptance, bare `Needle.lowers` rejection, deterministic parse/canonical semantic hashes, mutation discrimination and canonical roundtrip. Then resume WP-03 IR/types without semantic redesign unless a new executable counterexample appears.
invalidators: A newer exact-main frontend candidate already proves all WP-02 acceptance receipts without the V6 regression
Project owner supersedes the BASE ClayCode release gate
